title: No Fly February
description: No Fly February is a monthly event held every February to celebrate the alternative ways of getting around in Minecraft! Leave your Elytra and teleportation powers behind, and embrace the journey along the beaten path. Travel by minecart, horseback, or boat, and take the opportunity to visit friends and spend some extended time together. A fan-favourite event on the server, No Fly February is completely optional, so everyone is welcome to participate at their own pace!
